items: USPS files 5.9% increase, permanent 11% fuel surcharge. The Nov. 12 filing with the Postal Regulatory Commission would raise Priority Mail, Priority Mail Express, Ground Advantage and Parcel Select prices by an average of 5.9%. It would also convert April's 8% transportation-related change into a permanent 11% fuel surcharge, effective Jan. 17 pending PRC review.

UPS lifts fuel surcharge percentages 0.50 points. New tables effective Nov. 16 replace the Nov. 2 tables, and Ground, Ground Saver and Domestic Air percentages are each 0.50 points higher at the same fuel price. The file also adds an International Ground Export/Import table.

UPS raises China-to-U.S. surge emergency fee. The Surge Emergency Fee on China, Hong Kong and Macau shipments to the U.S. rises from $0.91 to $1.03 per lb. on Nov. 16. UPS also set a separate $0.89 per lb. fee for India and ended the Argentina-to-U.S. fee on Nov. 8.
